subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is only enabled in Development; HTTP requests in other environments are never redirected or rejected
findings.recommendation: Call webApp.UseHttpsRedirection() unconditionally (or gate it on `!IsDevelopment()` if HTTPS is terminated by a reverse proxy only outside dev) and add webApp.UseHsts() for non-development environments.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No security response headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, HSTS) are set anywhere in the pipeline

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) { ... webApp.UseMiddleware<UnhandledExceptionMiddleware>(); webApp.MapControllers(); }

findings.recommendation: Add a small middleware (or `UseSecurityHeaders`-style extension) that sets Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY (or frame-ancestors 'none') and Strict-Transport-Security on every response.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Error responses return a sanitized ProblemDetails message; no stack traces or internal details are leaked to the client

evidence.excerpt: var loggingCorrelation = LoggingUtilities.GetLoggingCorrelation(); this.logger.LogError(exception, "{UserMessage}", loggingCorrelation.UserMessage); ... Detail = loggingCorrelation.UserMessage
